annotation.title_clean: 商务部等9部门关于进一步激发下沉市场活力 活跃县域消费的意见
annotation.title_en: Opinions of the Ministry of Commerce and 8 Other Departments on Further Stimulating the Vitality of Lower-Tier Markets and Invigorating County-Level Consumption
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 商务部; 国家发展改革委; 财政部; 人力资源社会保障部; 自然资源部; 农业农村部; 文化和旅游部; 市场监管总局; 金融监管总局
annotation.summary_en: Chinese multi-ministry opinions to stimulate lower-tier market and county-level consumption through upgraded retail channels, business format innovation, supply improvement, logistics modernization, employment support, financing and land policy. AI is mentioned only in passing ("AI+consumption"); no robotics governance.
key_provisions_or_claims: Upgrade county commercial facilities and optimize retail network layout
Simplify approvals for chains; 'one license, multiple addresses'
Encourage emerging formats including 'AI+consumption' and VR
Fiscal interest subsidies, loans and flexible land supply for county commerce
Strengthen consumer rights protection and platform responsibilities
